chapter: Dancing schools and Charlie Johnson in New York
title: Bobby Johnson, Jimmy Harrison and the Johnson drummer
summary: The two discuss Bobby Johnson on banjo, Jimmy Harrison on trombone and the drummer, George Stafford, a sharp dresser.

story.theme_name: Trombonists: who they heard, admired and learned from
story.community_name: Talking trombonists: who played the slide and how

blocks.x: And Bobby Johnson, was he Charlie Johnson's brother?
No. Bobby was a tall fellow about your built, but tall. And he played banjo, right? Great banjo player. Then he went to guitar later.
And Jimmy Harrison was also in that band.
Yeah. Well you know Jimmy Harrison was one of the top trombone players in the country.
Was one of the finest drummers that ever sat behind a set of drums.
Yes, indeed! Real cool. Fine dresser. Looked like a movie star. Ladies man. Beautiful guy.
